name: ComfyUI工作台预设 · Studio
presetYaml:
- id: mcp-noobai
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: noobai
    transport: streamable-http
    url: http://127.0.0.1:18943/mcp
    headers:
      Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.NOOBAI_MCP_TOKEN}`'
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000
    failOnStartupError: true
- id: command-goal
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
- id: tool-goal
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
- id: tool-jobs
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
  config:
    completionDelivery: wakeup
- id: agent-instructions
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
  config:
    maxBytes: 65536
- id: tool-working-directory
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-working-directory'
- id: workbench-composition
  name: /Users/fzfz/.codex/worktrees/agent-studio-integration/harness-comfyui/.local/desktop-development/studio-data-environment/dsh-home/profiles/desktop/node_modules/harness-comfyui/agent-presets/workbench-composition.mjs
  config:
    omittedRuntimeContexts:
      - harness:source
      - app:web-surface
    deniedTools:
      - load_workspace_dependencies
- id: tool-bash
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
  disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
  config:
    enableRunInBackground: false
- id: tool-pwsh
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
  config:
    enableRunInBackground: false
- id: workbench-tools
  name: harness-comfyui/workbench-tools
- id: tool-presentation
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation'
  config:
    mode: native
- id: workbench-skills
  name: cordis:group
  group: true
  isolate:
    skills: true
  config:
    - id: skills
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill'
    - id: skill-filesystem
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
      config:
        includeDefaultRoots: false
        bundledSkillDir: !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('harness-comfyui/package.json')), '.agents', 'skills')
        customSkillDirs: []
    - id: tool-skill
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
- id: tool-subagent-list
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
- id: compaction
  name: cordis:group
  group: true
  isolate:
    compaction: true
    toolResultPruner: true
  config:
    - id: compaction-basic
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
    - id: command-compact
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
    - id: tool-result-pruner
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
      config:
        thresholdChars: 8192
        headChars: 4096
        tailChars: 1024
- id: task-agent
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  config:
    provider: spawn
    maxDepth: 1
- id: tool-subagent-control
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'

name: 翻译预设 · Studio
presetYaml:
- id: translation-composition
  name: /Users/fzfz/.codex/worktrees/agent-studio-integration/harness-comfyui/.local/desktop-development/studio-data-environment/dsh-home/profiles/desktop/node_modules/harness-comfyui/agent-presets/translation-composition.mjs
- id: translation-model
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model'
  isolate:
    agentDefaultModel: true
  config:
    provider: lan-gpt
    model: gpt-6-luna

  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation'
  config:
    mode: native
- id: translation-skills
  name: cordis:group
  group: true
  isolate:
    skills: true
  config:
    - id: skills
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill'
